description: Figure 10 illustrates the relationship between activated parameters ratio and evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) for different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL” and has a linear scale ranging from 11.0 to 14.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. There are three lines displayed on the plot. A blue solid line, representing “Transformer”, begins at approximately 13.65 Eval PPL at 0% activated parameters ratio and decreases to approximately 12.25 Eval PPL at 100% activated parameters ratio. A green dashed line, representing “Only MoHD FFN”, starts at approximately 13.1 Eval PPL at 0% activated parameters ratio and declines to approximately 11.65 Eval PPL at 100% activated parameters ratio. Finally, a purple dashed line, representing “MoHD ATTN + MLP”, begins at approximately 12.8 Eval PPL at 0% activated parameters ratio and decreases to approximately 11.25 Eval PPL at 100% activated parameters ratio.
